title: C41 Zrcadlo
prompt: Medium shot of a tall ornate antique standing mirror with a cracked black iron frame in a dark empty stone hall, a bolt of bright orange chaos lightning strikes the mirror from the left and the mirror surface ripples like liquid and fires an identical mirrored bolt of orange chaos lightning back out, glowing orange cracks across the glass, orange sparks and smoke. No people, no reflections of people. Background: cold dark teal hall, strong contrast of glowing orange chaos against cold dark teal. No text.

title: C07 Stit
prompt: Wide shot of a dark stone castle wall on a hill protected by a huge curved translucent barrier of bright orange chaos energy made of crackling glowing hexagons, incoming boulders and flaming arrows shatter and burst into orange sparks against the barrier, orange lightning running along its surface. No people. Background: bright golden yellow to orange sky with dust clouds. Palette: gold, amber, bright orange, dark grey stone, no teal. No text.

title: C11 Chaos a rad
prompt: Low-angle shot of one tall castle tower split down the middle: the left half is built of perfectly neat smooth pale stone blocks with calm cold blue order runes, the right half is twisted, jagged, growing chaotic stone glowing with bright orange chaos cracks and crackling orange lightning, both halves rising together and holding each other in balance, orange sparks on the right, blue mist on the left. No people. Background: sky split between cold dark teal on the left and hot orange-red on the right. No text.

title: C19 Knihovna

title: C31 Vymenik
